cases.context:
open Matrix MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
set_option autoImplicit false
definition_context: orthogonalHaar n is normalized Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group O(n), not Haar on the special orthogonal subgroup. For each sign the specified set restriction has mass 1/2, so scaling the restricted measure by 2 gives a probability.

singleBlockPrecision κ O is the real symmetric matrix \(A_O=((\kappa+1)/2)I-((\kappa-1)/4)(O+O^\top)\). Under the stated parameter bounds it is positive definite, so the matrix inverse in the centered multivariate Gaussian is the actual covariance.

The measure bind integrates each Borel event mass against its prior; Measure.real is the finite event mass as a real number. The set in sSup consists of all absolute differences for the same Borel event, not the L¹ distance of densities.
cases.statement:
example {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let μ := orthogonalHaar n
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    let Ppos := νpos.bind γ
    let Pneg := νneg.bind γ
    let δ : ℝ := sSup {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      MeasurableSet B ∧ z = |Ppos.real B - Pneg.real B|}
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(5 * (n : ℝ)) / s) ≤
      (((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ n) /
        (2 + 4 * (n : ℝ) * s / (s + 1) ^ 2) ∧
    (((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ n) /
        (2 + 4 * (n : ℝ) * s / (s + 1) ^ 2) ≤ δ
